The '''Dohlbani sector''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It contained the [[Apoka system/Legends|Apoka system]], home to the [[Apokan silveroak]]; the [[Dohlban system/Legends|Dohlban system]], which lay on the [[Kaaga Run/Legends|Kaaga Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]; and the [[Thrynka system/Legends|Thrynka system]]. The Dohlban [[Star system/Legends|system]] was also the site of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Dohlban|same name]], which was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Guineo]]s. At some point, the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Jhensara]] traveled to the Thrynka system but encountered an [[asteroid storm]] while in transit.

==Description==
The Dohlbani [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Slice" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Lannik Wilds]] sector [[spinward]] and the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan]] and [[Endocray sector/Legends|Endocray sectors]] in the [[trailing]] direction. The sector also formed a part of the Mid Rim's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] border with the Outer Rim Territories' [[Klina sector/Legends|Klina sector]].<ref name="Mid Rim" />

The northern section of the Dohlbani sector contained the [[Dohlban system/Legends|Dohlban system]], and the [[Apoka system/Legends|Apoka]] and [[Thrynka system/Legends|Thrynka systems]] lay in the sector's southern portion.<ref name="Directions">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places the Dohlbani [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]] of [[Dohlban system/Legends|Dohlban]] in grid square R-13 and [[Apoka system/Legends|Apoka]] and [[Thrynka system/Legends|Thrynka]] in square R-14, which corresponds to the northern and southern section of the sector, respectively, according to {{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}.</ref> The [[Kaaga Run/Legends|Kaaga Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the Dohlban [[Star system/Legends|system]] to [[Void Station]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> in the Bothan sector<ref name="Mid Rim" /> and to the [[Nar Kaaga system/Legends|Nar Kaaga system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
The Dohlban system contained the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Dohlban|same name]], which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Guineo]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="BH" /> The Apoka system was home to the [[Plant/Legends|plant]] known as [[Apokan silveroak]].<ref name="Incredible Vehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Apokan silveroak]]|system=[[Apoka system/Legends|Apoka system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

At some point, the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Jhensara]] acquired a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] with a full cargo-hold and then traveled to the<ref name="Journal7">{{JournalCite|7|The History of R-Series Astromech Droids}}</ref> sector's<ref name="EAOC" /> Thrynka system,<ref name="Journal7">{{JournalCite|7|The History of R-Series Astromech Droids}}</ref> where she planned to sell the goods she was [[Transport/Legends|transporting]]. However, while in transit, Jhensara's ship approached an [[asteroid storm]], and she quickly determined that she had not, in fact, arrived at her destination.<ref name="Journal7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dohlbani sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]," which placed it in grid squares R-13, R-14, and S-14.<ref name="Mid Rim" />
